summary.text: Ayden Scott, an unaffiliated candidate for Utah's 3rd Congressional District, lost the November 3, 2026 general election to Celeste Maloy.
Scott received 1.6% of the vote to Celeste Maloy's 57.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
